author: KEXP
description: The KEXP Live Room transforms into an enchanted space with live music from Wildwood Sessions, Music Inspired by LAIKA's Wildwood. With Wildwood novelist Colin Meloy, Portland artists Quickly Quickly, Ringdown, and Omari Jazz, Bocha & Donte Thomas come together for one special Live on KEXP session bringing the themes of the story to life.
title: LAIKA's Wildwood Sessions featuring Portland artists are available on our channel.

author: KEXP
description:
KEXP.ORG and LAIKA present Wildwood Sessions live on KEXP. Recorded September 11, 2026.

Songs:
Colin Meloy - I Want To Be Lost
Ringdown - The Hill
quickly, quickly - That's Enough For Me
Omari Jazz, Bocha, Donte Thomas - Nature In Me

Colin Meloy - Guitar, Vocals

Ringdown:
Danni Lee Parpan - Synth, Vocals
Caroline Shaw - Viola, Vocals
Leah Vautar - Percussion, Piano
Aaron Peterson - Trumpet, Piano

Quickly, Quickly:
Graham Jonson - Piano, Vocals
Elliot Cleverdon - Electric Guitar
Henry Earle - Bass
Kirk Kalbfleisch - Drums
Zachary Schleiker - Acoustic Guitar

Omari Jazz - Tracks
Bocha - Vocals
Donte Thomas - Vocals

Host: Cheryl Waters
Audio Engineer: Kevin Suggs
Mastering Engineer: Matt Ogaz

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz,  Brady Harvey & Luke Knecht
Editor: Jim Beckmann
